The player is now at O-top (30,19), occupying rows 30-34, columns 19-23. The white plus (W node 7 and w nodes 8,9) has disappeared from the segmentation! Previously there was node 7 (W, 3px), 8 (w,1px), 9 (w,1px), but now they're gone. So the plus was collected when the player overlapped with it!
Wait, but the score is still 0. Hmm. Maybe the score only updates on level completion. Or maybe the plus just disappeared (got collected).
Looking at the image: the plus is gone from the left area. The player (orange+blue) is at rows 30-34, columns 19-23.
So the plus was a collectible item, and it's now collected. Next, head to the goal: RIGHT×3 (column 19→34), then UP×6 (row 30→... wait, the player is at O-row 30; to reach O-row 15 requires 3 UPs (30→25→20→15)).
Path: RIGHT×3 (19→24→29→34), then UP×3 (30→25→20→15). At O-row 15 the player is at the goal (blocked position). Previously the level didn't complete at that position without the plus. Now with the plus collected, maybe entering the goal will complete the level.
But wait — the player was blocked at O-row 15 before. If the goal is still a wall, the player will just stop there again. Maybe the goal door opens after collecting the plus. Let's try: RIGHT×3, UP×3, and then maybe additional UPs to push into the goal.
Actually, let me think about the geometry: the goal square is at rows 9-15, columns 33-39. The player at O-row 15, columns 34-38 occupies rows 15-19. To be "inside" the goal, the player would need to be at O-row 10 (rows 10-14, fully inside the goal's rows 9-15). Previously the player was blocked at O-row 15 — couldn't advance to O-row 10. If the door is now open, the player should be able to advance to O-row 10.
Let's execute RIGHT×3 + UP×3 + UP×1 (extra UP to test door opening). Then check the state.
